+ ? and t_c_firstyear.dyear = ? and t_c_secyear.dyear = ? + ? and t_w_firstyear.dyear = ? and t_w_secyear.dyear = ? + ? and t_s_firstyear.year_total > ? and t_c_firstyear.year_total > ? and t_w_firstyear.year_total > ? and case when t_c_firstyear.year_total > ? then t_c_secyear.year_total / t_c_firstyear.year_total else ? end > case when t_s_firstyear.year_total > ? then t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total else ? select sum(ss_quantity) as "_col_0" from store_sales, store, customer_demographics, customer_address, date_dim where s_store_sk = ss_store_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and ((cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = ? and cd_education_status = ? and ss_sales_price between ? and ?) or (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = ? and cd_education_status = ? and ss_sales_price between ? and ?) or (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = ? and cd_education_status = ? and ss_sales_price between ? and ?)) and ((ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = ? and ca_state IN (?.. ) and ss_net_profit between ? and ?) or (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = ? and ca_state IN (?.. ) and ss_net_profit between ? and ?) or (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = ? and ca_state IN (?.. ) and ss_net_profit between ? and ?))

select ? as channel, web.item, web.return_ratio, web.return_rank, web.currency_rank from (select item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, rank() over (order by return_ratio) as return_rank, rank() over (order by currency_ratio) as currency_rank from (select ws.ws_item_sk as item, (cast(sum(coalesce(wr.wr_return_quantity, ?)) as dec(?, ?)) / cast(sum(coalesce(ws.ws_quantity, ?)) as dec(?, ?))) as return_ratio, (cast(sum(coalesce(wr.wr_return_amt, ?)) as dec(?, ?)) / cast(sum(coalesce(ws.ws_net_paid, ?)) as dec(?, ?))) as currency_ratio from web_sales as ws left outer join web_returns as wr on (ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number and ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk), date_dim where wr.wr_return_amt > ? and ws.ws_net_profit > ? and ws.ws_net_paid > ? and ws.ws_quantity > ? and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? group by ws.ws_item_sk) as in_web) as web where (web.return_rank <= ? or web.currency_rank <= ?) union select ? as channel, catalog.item, catalog.return_ratio, catalog.return_rank, catalog.currency_rank from (select item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, rank() over (order by return_ratio) as return_rank, rank() over (order by currency_ratio) as currency_rank from (select cs.cs_item_sk as item, (cast(sum(coalesce(cr.cr_return_quantity, ?)) as dec(?, ?)) / cast(sum(coalesce(cs.cs_quantity, ?)) as dec(?, ?))) as return_ratio, (cast(sum(coalesce(cr.cr_return_amount, ?)) as dec(?, ?)) / cast(sum(coalesce(cs.cs_net_paid, ?)) as dec(?, ?))) as currency_ratio from catalog_sales as cs left outer join catalog_returns as cr on (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number and cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk), date_dim where cr.cr_return_amount > ? and cs.cs_net_profit > ? and cs.cs_net_paid > ? and cs.cs_quantity > ? and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? group by cs.cs_item_sk) as in_cat) as catalog where (catalog.return_rank <= ? or catalog.currency_rank <= ?) union select ? as channel, store.item, store.return_ratio, store.return_rank, store.currency_rank from (select item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, rank() over (order by return_ratio) as return_rank, rank() over (order by currency_ratio) as currency_rank from (select sts.ss_item_sk as item, (cast(sum(coalesce(sr.sr_return_quantity, ?)) as dec(?, ?)) / cast(sum(coalesce(sts.ss_quantity, ?)) as dec(?, ?))) as return_ratio, (cast(sum(coalesce(sr.sr_return_amt, ?)) as dec(?, ?)) / cast(sum(coalesce(sts.ss_net_paid, ?)) as dec(?, ?))) as currency_ratio from store_sales as sts left outer join store_returns as sr on (sts.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number and sts.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk), date_dim where sr.sr_return_amt > ? and sts.ss_net_profit > ? and sts.ss_net_paid > ? and sts.ss_quantity > ? and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? group by sts.ss_item_sk) as in_store) as store where (store.return_rank <= ? or store.currency_rank <= ?) order by ?, ?, ? limit ?

select s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= ?) then ? else ? end) as "? days", sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > ?) and (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= ?) then ? else ? end) as "?-? days", sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > ?) and (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= ?) then ? else ? end) as "?-? days", sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > ?) and (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= ?) then ? else ? end) as "?-? days", sum(case when (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > ?) then ? else ? end) as ">? days" from store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim as d1, date_dim as d2 where d2.d_year = ? and d2.d_moy = ? and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk and sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk group by s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip order by s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip limit ?

with web_v1 as (select ws_item_sk as item_sk, d_date, sum(sum(ws_sales_price)) over (partition by ws_item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cume_sales from web_sales, date_dim where ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between ? and ? + ? and ws_item_sk is not ? group by ws_item_sk, d_date), store_v1 as (select ss_item_sk as item_sk, d_date, sum(sum(ss_sales_price)) over (partition by ss_item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cume_sales from store_sales, date_dim where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between ? and ? + ? and ss_item_sk is not ? group by ss_item_sk, d_date) select * from (select item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, max(web_sales) over (partition by item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as web_cumulative, max(store_sales) over (partition by item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as store_cumulative from (select case when web.item_sk is not ? then web.item_sk else store.item_sk end as item_sk, case when web.d_date is not ? then web.d_date else store.d_date end as d_date, web.cume_sales as web_sales, store.cume_sales as store_sales from web_v1 as web full outer join store_v1 as store on (web.item_sk = store.item_sk and web.d_date = store.d_date)) as x) as y where web_cumulative > store_cumulative order by item_sk, d_date limit ?

select dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id as brand_id, item.i_brand as brand, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as ext_price from date_dim as dt, store_sales, item where dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk and store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk and item.i_manager_id = ? and dt.d_moy = ? and dt.d_year = ? group by dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id order by dt.d_year, ext_price desc, brand_id limit ?

with ss as (select i_item_id, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as total_sales from store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item where i_item_id in (select i_item_id from item where i_color IN (?.. )) and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? and ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_gmt_offset = -? group by i_item_id), cs as (select i_item_id, sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as total_sales from catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item where i_item_id in (select i_item_id from item where i_color IN (?.. )) and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? and cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_gmt_offset = -? group by i_item_id), ws as (select i_item_id, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as total_sales from web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item where i_item_id in (select i_item_id from item where i_color IN (?.. )) and ws_item_sk = i_item_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? and ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_gmt_offset = -? group by i_item_id) select i_item_id, sum(total_sales) as total_sales from (select * from ss union all select * from cs union all select * from ws) as tmp1 group by i_item_id order by total_sales limit ?

with v1 as (select i_category, i_brand, cc_name, d_year, d_moy, sum(cs_sales_price) as sum_sales, avg(sum(cs_sales_price)) over (partition by i_category, i_brand, cc_name, d_year) as avg_monthly_sales, rank() over (partition by i_category, i_brand, cc_name order by d_year, d_moy) as rn from item, catalog_sales, date_dim, call_center where cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and cc_call_center_sk = cs_call_center_sk and (d_year = ? or (d_year = ? - ? and d_moy = ?) or (d_year = ? + ? and d_moy = ?)) group by i_category, i_brand, cc_name, d_year, d_moy), v2 as (select v1.i_brand, v1.d_year, v1.avg_monthly_sales, v1.sum_sales, v1_lag.sum_sales as psum, v1_lead.sum_sales as nsum from v1, v1 as v1_lag, v1 as v1_lead where v1.i_category = v1_lag.i_category and v1.i_category = v1_lead.i_category and v1.i_brand = v1_lag.i_brand and v1.i_brand = v1_lead.i_brand and v1.cc_name = v1_lag.cc_name and v1.cc_name = v1_lead.cc_name and v1.rn = v1_lag.rn + ? and v1.rn = v1_lead.rn - ?) select * from v2 where d_year = ? and avg_monthly_sales > ? and case when avg_monthly_sales > ? then abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales else ? end > ? order by sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, ? limit ?

with ss as (select i_item_id, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as total_sales from store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item where i_item_id in (select i_item_id from item where i_category in (?)) and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? and ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_gmt_offset = -? group by i_item_id), cs as (select i_item_id, sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as total_sales from catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item where i_item_id in (select i_item_id from item where i_category in (?)) and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? and cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_gmt_offset = -? group by i_item_id), ws as (select i_item_id, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as total_sales from web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item where i_item_id in (select i_item_id from item where i_category in (?)) and ws_item_sk = i_item_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and d_moy = ? and ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_gmt_offset = -? group by i_item_id) select i_item_id, sum(total_sales) as total_sales from (select * from ss union all select * from cs union all select * from ws) as tmp1 group by i_item_id order by i_item_id, total_sales limit ?

with year_total as (select c_customer_id as customer_id, c_first_name as customer_first_name, c_last_name as customer_last_name, d_year as year1, sum(ss_net_paid) as year_total, ? as sale_type from customer, store_sales, date_dim where c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year in (?, ? + ?) group by c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year union all select c_customer_id as customer_id, c_first_name as customer_first_name, c_last_name as customer_last_name, d_year as year1, sum(ws_net_paid) as year_total, ? as sale_type from customer, web_sales, date_dim where c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year in (?, ? + ?) group by c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year) select t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name from year_total as t_s_firstyear, year_total as t_s_secyear, year_total as t_w_firstyear, year_total as t_w_secyear where t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id and t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id and t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id and t_s_firstyear.sale_type = ? and t_w_firstyear.sale_type = ? and t_s_secyear.sale_type = ? and t_w_secyear.sale_type = ? and t_s_firstyear.year1 = ? and t_s_secyear.year1 = ? + ? and t_w_firstyear.year1 = ? and t_w_secyear.year1 = ? + ? and t_s_firstyear.year_total > ? and t_w_firstyear.year_total > ? and case when t_w_firstyear.year_total > ? then t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total else ? end > case when t_s_firstyear.year_total > ? then t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total else ? end order by ?, ?, ? limit ?

with all_sales as (select d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, sum(sales_cnt) as sales_cnt, sum(sales_amt) as sales_amt from (select d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, cs_quantity - coalesce(cr_return_quantity, ?) as sales_cnt, cs_ext_sales_price - coalesce(cr_return_amount, ?) as sales_amt from catalog_sales join item on i_item_sk = cs_item_sk join date_dim on d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk left join catalog_returns on (cs_order_number = cr_order_number and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) where i_category = ? union select d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ss_quantity - coalesce(sr_return_quantity, ?) as sales_cnt, ss_ext_sales_price - coalesce(sr_return_amt, ?) as sales_amt from store_sales join item on i_item_sk = ss_item_sk join date_dim on d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk left join store_returns on (ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk) where i_category = ? union select d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ws_quantity - coalesce(wr_return_quantity, ?) as sales_cnt, ws_ext_sales_price - coalesce(wr_return_amt, ?) as sales_amt from web_sales join item on i_item_sk = ws_item_sk join date_dim on d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk left join web_returns on (ws_order_number = wr_order_number and ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk) where i_category = ?) as sales_detail group by d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id) select prev_yr.d_year as prev_year, curr_yr.d_year as year1, curr_yr.i_brand_id, curr_yr.i_class_id, curr_yr.i_category_id, curr_yr.i_manufact_id, prev_yr.sales_cnt as prev_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt as curr_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt as sales_cnt_diff, curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt as sales_amt_diff from all_sales as curr_yr, all_sales as prev_yr where curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id and curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id and curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id and curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id and curr_yr.d_year = ? and prev_yr.d_year = ? - ? and cast(curr_yr.sales_cnt as decimal(?, ?)) / cast(prev_yr.sales_cnt as decimal(?, ?)) < ? order by sales_cnt_diff limit ?

select channel, col_name, d_year, d_qoy, i_category, count(*) as sales_cnt, sum(ext_sales_price) as sales_amt from (select ? as channel, ? as col_name, d_year, d_qoy, i_category, ss_ext_sales_price as ext_sales_price from store_sales, item, date_dim where ss_hdemo_sk is ? and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk union all select ? as channel, ? as col_name, d_year, d_qoy, i_category, ws_ext_sales_price as ext_sales_price from web_sales, item, date_dim where ws_ship_hdemo_sk is ? and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and ws_item_sk = i_item_sk union all select ? as channel, ? as col_name, d_year, d_qoy, i_category, cs_ext_sales_price as ext_sales_price from catalog_sales, item, date_dim where cs_warehouse_sk is ? and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk) as foo group by channel, col_name, d_year, d_qoy, i_category order by channel, col_name, d_year, d_qoy, i_category limit ?

with ss as (select s_store_sk, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(ss_net_profit) as profit from store_sales, date_dim, store where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk group by s_store_sk), sr as (select s_store_sk, sum(sr_return_amt) as returns1, sum(sr_net_loss) as profit_loss from store_returns, date_dim, store where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) and sr_store_sk = s_store_sk group by s_store_sk), cs as (select cs_call_center_sk, sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(cs_net_profit) as profit from catalog_sales, date_dim where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) group by cs_call_center_sk), cr as (select cr_call_center_sk, sum(cr_return_amount) as returns1, sum(cr_net_loss) as profit_loss from catalog_returns, date_dim where cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) group by cr_call_center_sk), ws as (select wp_web_page_sk, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(ws_net_profit) as profit from web_sales, date_dim, web_page where ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) and ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk group by wp_web_page_sk), wr as (select wp_web_page_sk, sum(wr_return_amt) as returns1, sum(wr_net_loss) as profit_loss from web_returns, date_dim, web_page where wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) and wr_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk group by wp_web_page_sk) select channel, id, sum(sales) as sales, sum(returns1) as returns1, sum(profit) as profit from (select ? as channel, ss.s_store_sk as id, sales, coalesce(returns1, ?) as returns1, (profit - coalesce(profit_loss, ?)) as profit from ss left join sr on ss.s_store_sk = sr.s_store_sk union all select ? as channel, cs_call_center_sk as id, sales, returns1, (profit - profit_loss) as profit from cs, cr union all select ? as channel, ws.wp_web_page_sk as id, sales, coalesce(returns1, ?) as returns1, (profit - coalesce(profit_loss, ?)) as profit from ws left join wr on ws.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wp_web_page_sk) as x group by rollup (channel, id) order by channel, id limit ?

with ws as (select d_year as ws_sold_year, ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk as ws_customer_sk, sum(ws_quantity) as ws_qty, sum(ws_wholesale_cost) as ws_wc, sum(ws_sales_price) as ws_sp from web_sales left join web_returns on wr_order_number = ws_order_number and ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk join date_dim on ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk where wr_order_number is ? group by d_year, ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk), cs as (select d_year as cs_sold_year, cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk as cs_customer_sk, sum(cs_quantity) as cs_qty, sum(cs_wholesale_cost) as cs_wc, sum(cs_sales_price) as cs_sp from catalog_sales left join catalog_returns on cr_order_number = cs_order_number and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk join date_dim on cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk where cr_order_number is ? group by d_year, cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk), ss as (select d_year as ss_sold_year, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, sum(ss_quantity) as ss_qty, sum(ss_wholesale_cost) as ss_wc, sum(ss_sales_price) as ss_sp from store_sales left join store_returns on sr_ticket_number = ss_ticket_number and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk where sr_ticket_number is ? group by d_year, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk) select ss_item_sk, round(ss_qty / (coalesce(ws_qty + cs_qty, ?)), ?) as ratio, ss_qty as store_qty, ss_wc as store_wholesale_cost, ss_sp as store_sales_price, coalesce(ws_qty, ?) + coalesce(cs_qty, ?) as other_chan_qty, coalesce(ws_wc, ?) + coalesce(cs_wc, ?) as other_chan_wholesale_cost, coalesce(ws_sp, ?) + coalesce(cs_sp, ?) as other_chan_sales_price from ss left join ws on (ws_sold_year = ss_sold_year and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk and ws_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk) left join cs on (cs_sold_year = ss_sold_year and cs_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cs_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk) where coalesce(ws_qty, ?) > ? and coalesce(cs_qty, ?) > ? and ss_sold_year = ? order by ss_item_sk, ss_qty desc, ss_wc desc, ss_sp desc, other_chan_qty, other_chan_wholesale_cost, other_chan_sales_price, round(ss_qty / (coalesce(ws_qty + cs_qty, ?)), ?) limit ?

select c_last_name, c_first_name, substr(s_city, ?, ?) as "_col_2", ss_ticket_number, amt, profit from (select ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, store.s_city, sum(ss_coupon_amt) as amt, sum(ss_net_profit) as profit from store_sales, date_dim, store, household_demographics where store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk and store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk and (household_demographics.hd_dep_count = ? or household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > ?) and date_dim.d_dow = ? and date_dim.d_year in (?, ? + ?, ? + ?) and store.s_number_employees between ? and ? group by ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, ss_addr_sk, store.s_city) as ms, customer where ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk order by c_last_name, c_first_name, substr(s_city, ?, ?), profit limit ?

with ssr as (select s_store_id as store_id, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(coalesce(sr_return_amt, ?)) as returns1, sum(ss_net_profit - coalesce(sr_net_loss, ?)) as profit from store_sales left outer join store_returns on (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number), date_dim, store, item, promotion where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and i_current_price > ? and ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk and p_channel_tv = ? group by s_store_id), csr as (select cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_page_id, sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(coalesce(cr_return_amount, ?)) as returns1, sum(cs_net_profit - coalesce(cr_net_loss, ?)) as profit from catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk and cs_order_number = cr_order_number), date_dim, catalog_page, item, promotion where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) and cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and i_current_price > ? and cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk and p_channel_tv = ? group by cp_catalog_page_id), wsr as (select web_site_id, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(coalesce(wr_return_amt, ?)) as returns1, sum(ws_net_profit - coalesce(wr_net_loss, ?)) as profit from web_sales left outer join web_returns on (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk and ws_order_number = wr_order_number), date_dim, web_site, item, promotion where ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast(? as date) and (cast(? as date) + interval ? day) and ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk and ws_item_sk = i_item_sk and i_current_price > ? and ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk and p_channel_tv = ? group by web_site_id) select channel, id, sum(sales) as sales, sum(returns1) as returns1, sum(profit) as profit from (select ? as channel, ? || store_id as id, sales, returns1, profit from ssr union all select ? as channel, ? || catalog_page_id as id, sales, returns1, profit from csr union all select ? as channel, ? || web_site_id as id, sales, returns1, profit from wsr) as x group by rollup (channel, id) order by channel, id limit ?

with customer_total_return as (select cr_returning_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk, ca_state as ctr_state, sum(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) as ctr_total_return from catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address where cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = ? and cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk group by cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) select c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return from customer_total_return as ctr1, customer_address, customer where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return) * ? from customer_total_return as ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) and ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk and ca_state = ? and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk order by c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return limit ?

with sr_items as (select i_item_id as item_id, sum(sr_return_quantity) as sr_item_qty from store_returns, item, date_dim where sr_item_sk = i_item_sk and d_date in (select d_date from date_dim where d_week_seq in (select d_week_seq from date_dim where d_date IN (?.. ))) and sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk group by i_item_id), cr_items as (select i_item_id as item_id, sum(cr_return_quantity) as cr_item_qty from catalog_returns, item, date_dim where cr_item_sk = i_item_sk and d_date in (select d_date from date_dim where d_week_seq in (select d_week_seq from date_dim where d_date IN (?.. ))) and cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk group by i_item_id), wr_items as (select i_item_id as item_id, sum(wr_return_quantity) as wr_item_qty from web_returns, item, date_dim where wr_item_sk = i_item_sk and d_date in (select d_date from date_dim where d_week_seq in (select d_week_seq from date_dim where d_date IN (?.. ))) and wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk group by i_item_id) select sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty, sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / ? * ? as sr_dev, cr_item_qty, cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / ? * ? as cr_dev, wr_item_qty, wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / ? * ? as wr_dev, (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / ? as average from sr_items, cr_items, wr_items where sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id and sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id order by sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty limit ?
